title: Mood Score Weather Impact Daily Feed Freshness Gap
dataSources: Weather-station readings (`weatherstation:reading`), daily weather-impact rollups (`personalweather:daily`), sleep correlation records (`personalweather:sleep`), step correlation records (`personalweather:steps`), mood correlation records (`personalweather:mood`).
app: Local weather-station readings correlated with personal sleep, steps, mood, and outdoor-activity summaries in Splunk via scripted inputs and daily rollups.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalweather:mood
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by source_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>36
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects weather-impact feeds that have stopped producing daily records on schedule.
value: Correlation reports are useless when a weather or personal metric feed has quietly gone missing, so freshness has to come first.
implementation: Use a stable `source_name` field for each upstream weather or personal summary feed.
visualization: Table of daily feeds by hours since last record.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates when the data behind mood score weather impact is no longer arriving reliably each day.
